metadata.purpose: Before subscribing to source, synchronously emit all supplied prefix values in order, then forward source notifications.

conditions: Successful output begins with exactly the supplied prefix word, followed by the source word.
Prefix is not replayed in addition to each source value; cancellation during prefix prevents source acquisition.

scope.parameters: A finite frozen snapshot of supplied prefix values; no SchedulerLike argument.
scope.callbacks: No user projection. Prefix values are opaque and forwarded without inspection.
scope.time: Unscheduled prefix values are synchronous on subscription; source time begins only when subscribed. No internal clock or timer.
scope.reentrancy: Atomic non-reentrant prefix microsteps and source delivery; supports downstream cancellation between prefix emissions.
exclusions: Deprecated SchedulerLike overload, which uses scheduling and changes when the source is subscribed.
Throwing observer/finalizer, nested synchronous reentry or guaranteed physical producer abort.

initialization.sourceSubscription: After every prefix next, unless zero prefixes or downstream cancellation; no eager source connection.

ownership.sharing: No multicasting. Each result subscription repeats prefix and owns its own source subscription.
ownership.reset: New subscription starts from prefix index zero; closed execution is not restarted.

dispatch.actionSemantics: Synthetic prefix.next and prefix.complete microsteps model the synchronous concat(values,source) behavior; they are not source events or timers.
cancellationCheckpoints: After each prefix next and before source acquisition.
After source acquisition and between source events.

inputs.description: fresh downstream subscription begins prefix delivery
next configured prefix item is delivered synchronously
all prefix notifications finished; connect to source

controls.description: emitting configured values; source not yet connected

rules.explanation: Without prefix values, the source is subscribed to immediately and is forwarded unchanged.

actions: begin synchronous prefix delivery without subscribing to source
rules.explanation: At subscription, startWith emits its supplied values before connecting to the source. Construction of the pipeline is lazy.

actions: emit the current prefix payload synchronously
rules.explanation: Each configured prefix value is forwarded in argument order, including undefined, null and repeated values. It is emitted synchronously in the default unscheduled profile.

actions: subscribe source after the last prefix notification returns
rules.explanation: Only after the entire prefix sequence completes does startWith subscribe to the source. An observer that cancels during the prefix prevents source acquisition.

actions: stop prefix delivery; no source subscription to release
rules.explanation: Cancellation during prefix delivery suppresses remaining prefix values and prevents the source from ever being subscribed.
After the prefix, all source values flow unchanged in their original order and arrival times.
Once prefix delivery and the source finish, the output completes. An empty source still receives all prefix values first.
A source error arrives only after the prefix has been emitted. It passes through unchanged; no completion follows.
Cancellation after prefix completion releases the source and stops future values without synthesizing completion.
